headline_marked: [[PM Tareque Rahman visits Chattogram and Cox's Bazar]] to inspect projects, meet flood victims
headline: PM Tareque Rahman visits Chattogram and Cox's Bazar to inspect projects, meet flood victims
summary: Prime Minister Tareque Rahman is undertaking his first visit to Chattogram and Cox's Bazar since taking office in February. He will inspect major development projects and engage with communities affected by recent floods.
details: Prime Minister Tareque Rahman is on an official visit to Chattogram and Cox's Bazar today, marking his first trip to the region since assuming the premiership in February. The visit includes a comprehensive itinerary focused on development and community engagement.

The Prime Minister began his tour in Maheshkhali, Cox's Bazar, where he inspected the Matarbari deep sea port, the coal power project, and the activities of the Maheshkhali Integrated Development Authority (MIDA). These projects are crucial for the region's economic growth.

Following the inspections, he participated in a program at Paschim Banshkhali High School and College field in Baharchhara Union, aimed at rehabilitating victims of recent floods. This initiative underscores the government's commitment to supporting affected communities.

Later, PM Rahman visited the Al-Jamiyatul Islamia Azizul Ulum Babunagar Madrasa in Fatikchhari, Chattogram. He held a courtesy meeting with Allama Shah Muhibbullah Babunagari and paid respects at the grave of the late Allama Shah Ahmad Shafi.

The Prime Minister also attended another rehabilitation program for flood-affected residents at the Hathazari Government College field. These events highlight the ongoing efforts to provide relief and support to those impacted by natural disasters.

His day concluded with an organizational meeting at the Radisson Blu Hotel in Chattogram before his departure for Dhaka. The extensive visit covered various aspects of governance, development, and social welfare.

headline_marked: [[Lionel Messi misses Inter Miami game]] after father Jorge Messi dies at 68
headline: Lionel Messi misses Inter Miami game after father Jorge Messi dies at 68
summary: Lionel Messi was absent from Inter Miami's Leagues Cup match against Monterrey following the death of his father, Jorge Messi, in Argentina. Inter Miami lost the match 2-1.
details: Lionel Messi was absent from Inter Miami's Leagues Cup match against Monterrey following the death of his father, Jorge Messi. The team ultimately lost the game 2-1, with Messi having arrived in Argentina on Saturday night.
Jorge Messi passed away at the age of 68 in Argentina. Before the match, teams observed a minute of silence in his honor, acknowledging the profound loss.
Inter Miami released a statement expressing their condolences, saying, "Our hearts are with our captain, Leo, and the entire Messi family." The football world has also expressed its sorrow.

During the match, Argentine midfielder Rodrigo De Paul initially gave Miami a 1-0 lead in the 32nd minute. However, Monterrey equalized through Hugo Cuypers in the 47th minute, and Diego Rossi scored the winning goal in the 90th minute.
Despite the loss, Major League Soccer champions Miami had previously won their first group match 4-2 against Atletico San Luis. They are now set to face Leon in their next fixture on Wednesday.
